entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5610441600394646016: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 33856: distance 343.643 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.065), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 343.643 +/- 22.337 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 2.5085 +/- 0.1590 mas (same row, RUWE 2.55), 15.8 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -5.714, 4.890 mas/yr. entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 256.839 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 33856: radius 256.839 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 12254.2 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.093) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 3792 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 33856: effective temperature 3792 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.06).
